rows.grounds: tadvat (likewise) + ca (and) + adhaḥ (below); sandhi-resolved compound indicating similar worship below
absolutive of sam-abhi-arc (to worship thoroughly); describes prior ritual action
tad (that) + bahis (outside); indicates location exterior to the previously mentioned area
bhūpura (earth-enclosure), the outer enclosure of the śrīcakra; locative sense indicating place of worship
optative of yaj (to worship); prescribes the ritual action to be performed
